text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in the Rhein‑Erft district stood at 11.98 €/m², up 3.0 % year‑on‑year and 23.5 % over the past five years, placing the area 17th among the 37 most expensive German cities. The 25‑day average time on market and a 26 % share of listings let within a week underline a tight market, while the vacancy rate is only 1.2 %.

Asking rents sit 56 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 7.67 €/m², translating to roughly 719 € per month for a 60 m² unit and a rent‑burden of 15.3 % for two residents, highlighting affordability pressure.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 12.77 €/m² in 12 months, with a range of 12.41 – 13.13 €/m², implying a 6.6 % increase.
